rationale: The exact candidate assigns first_end and whole_order_end to 1906-01-13 and twice reasons that issuance occurred that day. Complete visual examination of PDF page 80, printed page 67, shows Theodore Roosevelt, The White House, January 12, 1906, and an immediate present-tense repeal (is hereby repealed). No delayed commencement, next-day implementation, or administrative period appears. The source therefore supports the self-executing repeal on January 12, not January 13. This is a substantive first-cessation/effective-date error in the exact selected version. Missing raw_path references also remain mechanically unresolved; independently reading the explicitly supplied raw book does not repair the card.

source_exam.identity: The book prints no EO number. January 12, 1906, appointments in the Isthmian Canal Commission on the Isthmus of Panama, repeal of the November 15, 1905 order, and Roosevelt signature agree with the two permitted IC1911 crosswalks for EO:393. The November 15 predecessor on printed page 62 authorizes temporary appointments when no register contains a specially qualified eligible, and permanence on certification; date, subject and signature agree with the crosswalk for EO:370. Adjacent same-day EO:394 is a different civil-service-rule amendment and is not substituted.

inventory_check: One operative repeal sentence, followed by signature and date. No continuing appointment authority, administrative command, schedule, conditional performance or express savings in EO:393. Body-only segmentation is substantively appropriate.
first_cessation_check: The legal transition is accomplished by the immediate repeal itself on January 12, 1906; its enduring cancellation consequence is separate from continuing operative work. No evidence of a January 13 issuance or legal transition. No earlier cessation of this newly issued repeal command is established or needed.
independent_duties_and_savings: The predecessor grants conditional permission; no appointment or certification performance is inferred. EO:393 neither removes appointees nor orders payment, recovery or new appointments. Existing appointment rights are not proved extinguished. Continuing consequences of repeal do not create a prospective independent command.
current_and_search_limits: Candidate carries bounded USC/eCFR/OFR number searches, not independent proof of every later legal development. USC edition omits October 10-14, 2026 enactments; OFR begins 1937 and number-only approaches can miss unnamed measures. No new network or canonical search performed. These limits do not cure the directly contradicted cessation date.
until_date_convention: No until date in the examined command. Any until date would include the final day with the exclusive reading disclosed.
